create_extractor: create an archive extractor using get_extractor with optional max_workers parameter
run_extract: run the _Extractor.extract method to asynchronously extract an archive to a destination path
test_iter_archive: test iter_archive to iterate over archive contents yielding file paths and file objects
review_iter_tar: review iter_tar to iterate over tar archive members with optional stream mode support
summarize_iter_zip: summarize iter_zip to iterate over zip archive entries filtering directories
